Only the locally served editor JS/CSS are used. Tentacles configures the supported
toolbar subset in js/promotional-pages.js. The server's PromotionalContentService
is authoritative for allowed stored and rendered HTML; the editor is not a
security boundary. No runtime CDN, framework, media upload, or code-view integration.
